title: “Lord, help me trust You in the hidden places. Teach me to rest in Your unseen protection, even when the waters feel uncertain.”
paragraphs: “Lord, help me trust You in the hidden places. Teach me to rest in Your unseen protection, even when the waters feel uncertain.”
When I read the Bible, it feels like I am there witnessing the moment.

I stand quietly by the riverbank as the basket is opened…
a fragile cry rising above the still water.

In that stillness, I feel the tension of danger—
and then the sudden mercy of compassion.

A child hidden to survive…
a princess moved with pity…
a future deliverer resting in trembling hands.
The river that could have carried death instead carries destiny.

How often does God protect what seems most vulnerable?
How often does His plan float quietly through uncertain waters?

I am only a witness to this sacred rescue—
but I leave wondering…
what “basket in the reeds” might He be guarding in my own life?
